title: A Generalized Hacker Dynamics Model with Nonlinear Incidence: Analysis and Positivity-Preserving Numerical Simulation
summary: We propose and analyze a generalized compartment model for hacker dynamics in cybersecurity systems. This model is an extension of a recently introduced framework, replacing the bilinear interaction term with a broad class of nonlinear incidence functions. This provides greater modeling flexibility and allows for the description of a wider range of cyber-propagation and information-spreading processes.
